help.buildDir: Path to the directory where all build files will be generated. Example: 'build'
help.enableSimd: Set to true to enable SIMD optimizations (vectorization). Set to false to disable.
help.simdInstructionSet: Which SIMD instruction set to use. Options: 'avx2', 'avx512', 'esp-dsp', 'none'. Default is 'avx2' if SIMD is enabled.
help.buildType: Type of build. Options: 'Release', 'Debug', 'AllGasNoBrakes' (for maximum performance).
help.jobs: Number of parallel compilation jobs. Set to the number of CPU cores for fastest builds.
help.target: Build target. Usually 'all' to build everything, or specify a target name.
help.config: Build configuration for multi-config generators (like Visual Studio or Xcode). Use 'Release' or 'Debug'.
